description: Source code for CodecOutputBufferRenderer class handling rendering of codec output buffers to textures, overlays, or front buffers in Android media GPU context.

classes.name: CodecOutputBufferRenderer
classes.description: Handles rendering of codec output buffers to various targets in Android media GPU context.

methods.name: RenderToTextureOwnerBackBuffer
methods.description: Renders the output buffer to the back buffer texture.

methods.name: RenderToTextureOwnerFrontBuffer
methods.description: Renders the output buffer to the front buffer texture, promoting from back buffer if needed.

methods.name: RenderToOverlay
methods.description: Renders the output buffer directly to an overlay surface.

methods.name: RenderToFrontBuffer
methods.description: Triggers early rendering of the buffer to the front buffer or overlay.

methods.name: EnsureBoundIfNeeded
methods.description: Ensures the texture is bound if required by the bindings mode.
